scope: Published third-party measurements; not new camera captures or verified version-specific results.

source.author: William J. Claff / Photons to Photos

reading_method: Download the original chart HTML without evaluating its JavaScript.
Locate exact series names Pentax K-3 II and Pentax K-3 III, excluding Monochrome.
Find the first point whose marker symbol is triangle-down (legend: noise reduction).
Convert x with ISO = round(3.125 * 2**x); use nominal ISO labels for intermediate rounded x values.
limits: Markers report detected NR, not a specific algorithm, kernel, control bit or ISO-independent guarantee.
Unmarked points do not establish absence of all RAW preprocessing.
Exact contributor camera firmware and individual file menu states were not independently verified.
The coordinator re-fetched PDR and confirmed its byte hash and both first-marker boundaries.
The official multi-dimensional filtering claim does not identify its position relative to RAW file storage.
